site.method: EIA Form 860M May 2026 plant coordinates, corroborated by Ch313 improvement map (SE Haskell County / north of Paint Creek ISD) and Sentinel-2 imagery showing large solar array at these coords
cross_checks: EIA 860M Plant coords: 33.144326N, -99.55977W (Planned sheet, Briggs Solar LLC / Intersect USA)
Ch313 improvement map shows project in SE Haskell County north of Paint Creek ISD boundary, consistent with ~33.14N, 99.56W
Sentinel-2 2026-07-01 chip at EIA coords confirms large partially-installed solar array
Adjacent Quantum II Solar (Intersect, 33.137N/99.57W) already substantially complete — confirms corridor

EIA 860M May 2026 lists Briggs Solar LLC plant with entity Intersect USA LLC; IP Quantum III name change and 'IP' prefix consistent with Intersect Power Quantum series in Haskell County (Quantum I/II already co-located at 33.01-33.14N, 99.56W); Google acquired Intersect Power (~$4.75B, Dec 2025)

frames.observation: Undisturbed ranchland — no construction activity, no clearing
Active grading and clearing visible; rectangular pads taking shape in left portion of frame; early substation stub visible at center; Quantum II footprint being established

Large solar array substantially constructed — dark module blocks across most footprint; major substation/data-center complex visible; Briggs footprint (northern portion) shows module installation in progress

satellite.note: Quantum II Solar (adjacent, COD Aug 2026) is largely complete. Briggs (Quantum III, COD Dec 2027) appears to be the northern portion of the same corridor where construction activity is visible but less complete than Quantum II

rationale: IA signed Mar 2025, 6.9(1) cleared Mar 2025 — contractual anchor is real
EIA 860M Dec 2027 vs ERCOT queue Apr 2028 — 4-month discrepancy, typical mid-construction timeline uncertainty
COD slipped 3.9 years total since original 2024-05 target — pattern of optimism
Active construction visible in 2026-07 imagery adjacent to Quantum II complex
Quantum II (identical scale, same developer/site) reportedly reached operations Aug 2026 — Briggs is the sequential phase
FIS approval still not in queue (unusual for project with IA signed 16 months ago) — mild concern
No financing announcement found (contrast with Hanson Solar which had confirmed close Nov 2025)
